symmGroup.statement: Let $\Omega$ be a measure space and let $G$ be an abelian group with a measurable space structure for which addition $G\times G\to G$ is measurable. For a measurable random variable $X:\Omega\to G$, this defines an additive subgroup $\mathrm{Sym}[X]$ of $G$. According to its docstring, it is the symmetry group of $X$: the set of all $h\in G$ such that $X+h$ has an identical distribution to $X$.
